name: Shea
source: Shura's deceased true love. Shea was kidnapped by an evil religious sect and was offered as a sacrifice to give birth to Deirdre. When Shura found her, she was already dead. Shea did not only die, but her soul was also consumed by Deirdre removing her from the cycle of reincarnation. Shea is never coming back.
